INTUITIVE® is a nationally recognized Best Place to Work that provides solutions from design through production to sustainment by delivering targeted results. Our approach couples the latest technology with engineering expertise and analytical proficiency while remaining true to genuine customer relationships and a culture that fosters growth and opportunity. Our diverse portfolio of capabilities and extensive customer base allows our employees countless opportunities to pursue their passions and support our nation’s Warfighters. Join our team that encourages creativity, welcomes initiative, and seeks excellence. Start Building Your Future today!
 
 We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer with Data Science experience that has a strong desire to work with Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) based technologies.  This role supports an Army customer's efforts in data storage, manipulation and analysis. This position will help guide key stakeholders understanding of AI/ML principles, define processes, and requirements as related to big data applications. This role requires current knowledge of best practices and emerging trends in AI/ML and its use for solving big data issues specifically in the development, management, and exploitation of current databases.  You'll need a comprehensive understanding of machine learning paradigms including ensemble, reinforcement, supervised, and semi-supervised learning. You’ll also need experience with related statistical analyses such as regression, cluster, rules-based, decision-tree, and semantic analysis to model and predict outcomes based on input data. To be successful in this role, you must have excellent written and verbal communication skills and an ability to demonstrate a passion for applying innovative ideas to develop cutting-edge solutions. This position will support the various needs of organizations across the Army aviation enterprise. This is an on-site position.
 
 Required 
 BS or BA degree
 7 years of related experience
 Strong foundation in statistics, probability, and linear algebra
 Experience with machine learning libraries and frameworks like TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn
 Proficiency in data manipulation and analysis using tools like Pandas, NumPy, and SQL
 Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance
 
 Desired 
 Strong experience with Microsoft 365 (M365) Power Platform, SharePoint Online, and Exchange Online (EXO) products and services
 Experience using advanced visualization software such as Kibana, Tableau, and PowerBI as well as visualization libraries like Matplotlib and D3.js to generate interactive reports and dashboards
